data.title: Jade Tower
data.about:
Jade Tower by Tiger Properties is a stunning testament to Majan’s luxury and magnificence near Dubailand. Embracing the sophisticated and elegant lifestyle of the area, Jade Tower in Dubai epitomizes abundant living. Select from studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each designed with contemporary style and sleek lines that celebrate the refinement and grace of Jade’s culture and heritage. This tower’s striking presence on the skyline embodies the luxury and grandeur of Jade while reflecting the beauty of its surroundings. It inspires all who see it, inviting them to experience the unparalleled beauty of Dubai.

This tower near Dubailand boasts a luxurious design and breathtaking structure that make every moment unforgettable. Discover the allure of Jade like never before, where every view from your window offers a new perspective, and every corner whispers tales of indulgence and sophistication.

Each Jade Tower Apartment is a masterpiece, blending classic craftsmanship with modern flair to create a living space that surpasses standard luxury. Jade Tower provides an experience that is as captivating as it is comfortable, inviting you to savor the beauty of your surroundings in unparalleled luxury and sophistication.

characteristics_module.title: Unmatched Elegance at Jade Tower by Tiger Properties
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Diverse Apartment Options: Studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom fully-furnished apartments with premium fittings and luxury furnishings.
  • Modern Urban Living: 28 residential floors with contemporary design and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Prime Location: Situated in Majan, Dubailand, offering easy access to key Dubai destinations.
  • Natural Light and Views: Floor-to-ceiling windows providing natural light and panoramic views.
  • Elegant Lobby: Exquisite finishes and elegant furnishings set the tone for exceptional living.
  • World-Class Amenities: Outdoor pool, state-of-the-art gyms, and dedicated kids' play areas.
  • Family-Friendly: Close to parks, schools, childcare, dining, and shopping options.
  • Security and Daycare: Top-notch security measures and comprehensive daycare services.
  • Iconic Landmarks: Breathtaking vistas and seamless connectivity to Dubailand's key locations.

location_tile.title: Enjoy Convienience & Connectivity at Majan, Dubailand.
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Majan is a vibrant 1.5 million square meter district in the heart of Dubailand. Ideal for buy-to-invest properties, Majan offers competitive apartment prices with opportunities for substantial discounts on off-plan units.

Strategically located near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road, Majan provides easy access to Al Ain, Sharjah, and Abu Dhabi. The district features 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels, and mixed-use units.

Proximity to top-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, amusement parks, and sports facilities makes Majan highly desirable. Despite its excellent location, rental rates are affordable, attracting both locals and tourists seeking quality housing at reasonable prices.

05 Mins from IMG World
07 Mins from Global Village
19 Mins from Palm Jumeirah
20 Mins from Dubai Mall
